text:
meera: quick flag — new reranker-tiny-int8 smoke shows -0.027 NDCG@10 vs fp16 on short-query slice. suspect candidate truncation + delim token bleeding into title tokens.

tony: can you share the eval cmd + which slice? short-query = queries < 20 chars?

meera: yes short-query <20 chars. command: `./eval/run.py --model rerank-tiny-int8 --holdout smoke-20k --slice short-query --k 10 --seed 99`. logs: https://artifacts/495123/summary.csv.

eli: Did ingest change? delimiter or title extraction?

meera: We changed concat to use a literal "||SEP||" and the doc truncation now keeps last 256 chars instead of first 256. That means for short queries the title fragment often ends up at tail and gets clipped differently.

tony: hmm that could reorder informative tokens and affect top-1. Try two quick probes: A) revert truncation (keep head), B) replace "||SEP||" with "\n\n" before tokenization. Also run with `--no-cache-kv` to rule out caching artifacts.

eval-bot: Run queued: job 55100 (variants A,B). artifacts: https://console.redwood/jobs/55100. ETA ~12m.

meera: updates in — variant A (head truncation) recovers +0.019 NDCG, variant B recovers +0.014. Combined likely eliminates gap. Per-query top1 flips CSV saved to artifacts.

eli: ok that points to truncate+delim changes. Action: add a bringup item: verify truncation head/tail parity across versions and canonicalize delimiter for eval. Also add a short-unit test that checks top1 agreement > 0.98 between fp16 and int8 on short-query smoke when formatting parity is enforced.

ton y: (typo) tony: agree. meera, file a ticket with repro and attach the per-query deltas.

meera: filed INF-5123: "reranker-tiny int8 bringup: truncation+delimiter parity" and pushed a tiny normalizer to the bringup branch. leaving artifacts and csv in job 55100. ping me for slices.

eli: thanks — will review the CSV and close once full PTQ flow is rerun with parity.
